# PLANET DESTROYER

**A pixel mining sandbox with a gambling problem.**

You are a greedy little alien with a drill and a debt. One million dollars, owed
to a shark in a suit called Mr Chum — because on the night the game opens you
got ten in a row on a machine called THE UNIVERSAL, and then you got the
eleventh.

So now you have a moon, a drill, and a very simple plan: fly to a world, dig it
open, sell everything inside it, and when the core goes it takes the whole
planet with it. Do that ten times and the galaxy is rubble and you are
obscenely rich.

You will not do that. You will go to the casino.

---

## WHAT IS IN IT

**Ten worlds, drilled to the core.** Forty ores across nine strata, thirteen
species of thing that lives down there, caves, magma, precursor ruins, and a
core chamber with something enormous standing in front of it. Break the core and
the world comes apart in one hard white frame.

**A four-storey casino under your moon.** A lift, and an atrium with a
chandelier hanging through all four floors. On each one, a different way to
lose:

- **THE FLOOR** — poker, roulette, blackjack, the cashier's cage, the bar, and a
  salon behind a velvet rope with dice, baccarat and a lounge singer who takes
  requests. The band plays whatever you ask her for.
- **THE ARCADE** — cabinets, a wall of televisions, and a claw machine full of
  rubber ducks that has never once held on to anything.
- **THE MENAGERIE** — sofas, a fountain, a wall of brains in jars, and the desk
  that will lend you anything you like at twenty-five per cent.
- **THE CROWN** — THE MEGA PLANET MACHINE. Ten thousand a pull, three worlds
  pays sixty times, and the jackpot board has never been reset because it has
  never been paid.

**Everything is drawn by code.** Not one sprite sheet, sound file or font in the
whole game. Every alien, every ore, every planet and every note of every one of
the twelve songs is generated at runtime. The characters come out of a trait
system, so the crowd is different every time — and mixed in with them are the
regulars, who you are fairly sure you have seen somewhere before: a robot, a
brain in a jar, a potted fern, an eight-foot sunflower, a lava lamp, an enormous
rubber duck, and a television on legs.

**A band that knows twelve numbers.** Chord progressions, swing, a walking bass
in the casino and half-time dread at the bottom of a world. Nobody picks the
track — it is chosen from whatever is on screen, and the band finishes the bar
it is on before it changes.

**And a loyalty card**, because of course there is. Every bet goes on your
account, win or lose. Bronze opens the rope. Silver stops the bar charging you.
Black leaves an envelope at the cage every time you walk in.

---

## CONTROLS

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **A / D** or arrow keys | walk |
| **W** / space | jump and thrust |
| **Mouse** | aim and drill |
| **E** | use, talk, bet |
| **ESC** | back |

It plays on a phone as well — the whole thing is touch-driven when there is no
keyboard in front of it.

---

*No engine. No asset files. Every pixel in here is drawn by code, every time it
runs.*

**Made by Pukking Dragon.**
